channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.202 highlights
item.description:
• Dynamic workflow size setting: small/medium/large agent counts (v2.1.202)
  • /review <pr> fast single-pass; /code-review for multi-agent review (v2.1.202)
  • Sonnet 5 no longer uses mid-conversation system role for harness reminders (v2.1.201)
  • Permission mode 'default' renamed to 'Manual' across CLI and IDEs (v2.1.200)
  • AskUserQuestion dialogs no longer auto-continue by default (v2.1.200)
  • Stacked slash-skill invocations load up to 5 leading skills at once (v2.1.199)
  • CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG raises retries to 300, lifts MAX_RETRIES cap (v2.1.199)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.202
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] dynamicWorkflowSize: Set dynamic workflow size: small/medium/large agent counts (advisory)
+ [slash-commands] /review <pr>: Fast single-pass PR review
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Multi-agent code review with effort; --comment for inline PR comments, --fix to apply findings
- [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell

Full changelog

• Added a "Dynamic workflow size" setting in `/config` for controlling how large Claude generally makes dynamic workflows (small/medium/large agent counts) — an advisory guideline, not an enforced cap
• Added `workflow.run_id` and `workflow.name` OpenTelemetry attributes to telemetry emitted by workflow-spawned agents, so a workflow run's activity can be reconstructed from OTel data
• Fixed a crash in the inline Ctrl+R history search when accepting or cancelling while the search was still scanning the history file
• Fixed `/rename` on background sessions being reverted when the job restarts, which broke addressing the session by its new name
• Fixed transient mTLS handshake failures when settings were re-applied during an in-place client certificate rotation
• Fixed commands sent from Remote Control (mobile/web) into an interactive session failing with "Unknown command"
• Fixed images and files sent from the Remote Control mobile or web app without a caption being silently dropped
• Fixed the sign-in URL printed by `claude auth login` and `claude mcp login --no-browser` not being reliably clickable when it wraps over SSH — it is now emitted as a single hyperlink
• Fixed opening a chat from `claude agents` sometimes failing with "currently running as a background agent" followed by a worker crash/respawn loop
• Fixed workflow scripts with unicode quote escapes in strings being corrupted before parsing; workflow parse errors now show the offending line instead of always blaming TypeScript
• Fixed voice dictation retrying in an unbounded loop when the microphone or audio recorder fails — repeated capture failures now pause voice input
• Fixed `/remote-control` sessions showing the wrong permission mode in the mobile and web apps
• Fixed resuming a session by name, or opening the resume picker, taking minutes and using a large amount of memory in repositories with many git worktrees
• Fixed installer and updater downloads failing immediately with "aborted" when a proxy or network drops the connection mid-download — transient connection drops now retry
• Fixed re-invoking an already-loaded skill appending a duplicate copy of its instructions to context
• Improved `/workflows` agent list layout: wider titles, a dedicated time column, shorter model names, and no per-row tool-call counts
• Improved MCP error messages: clearer error when a server config has `url` but no `type`, suggesting `"type": "http"` instead of the misleading "command: expected string"
• Changed `/review <pr>` back to a fast single-pass review; use `/code-review <level> <pr#>` for the multi-agent review at a chosen effort level

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.199
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Stacked invocation: Chain up to 5 skills: /skill-a /skill-b do XYZ
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: 300 retries for transient errors; lifts MAX_RETRIES cap of 15
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries; cap of 15 lifted when RETRY_WATCHDOG is set
- [skills-agents] root SKILL.md
- [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents
- [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.198
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] /dataviz: Chart and dashboard design guidance; runnable color-palette validator
~ [config-env] Notification: When Claude sends notification; agent_needs_input / agent_completed from bg agents
~ [skills-agents] Explore: Fast read-only (inherits session model, capped at opus)
~ [workflows-tips] isolation: worktree: Agent in own worktree; auto-commits, pushes, opens draft PR
- [slash-commands] /agents
- [skills-agents] slash commands (Skill)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.197

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG: Set 0 to disable; 5-min idle abort+retry on by default for all providers
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←: Open agents view
~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model; Org/Role default when admin sets one (←→ effort, s = session only)
~ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key / non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL disables RC, /schedule, MCP, notifications
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.195
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS: Disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode; wheel scroll still works
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.193
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell: Route all Bash/PowerShell commands through auto-mode classifier
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES: 1=log assistant responses in OTEL; 0=keep prompts-only; unset follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP: Set to 1 to disable automatic memory-pressure reaping of idle bg shells
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; file path autocomplete; Claude responds to output
- [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2"
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE
